1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. How blessed is the one who treats the poor properly. When trouble comes, may the Lord deliver him.

2.w: May the Lord protect him and save his life. May he be blessed in the land. Do not turn him over to his enemies.

3.w: The Lord supports him on his sickbed; you have healed him from his illness.

4.w: As for me, I said: “O Lord, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.

5.w: My enemies ask this cruel question about me, ‘When will he finally die and be forgotten?’

6.w: When someone comes to visit, he pretends to be friendly; he thinks of ways to defame me, and when he leaves he slanders me.

7.w: All who hate me whisper insults about me to one another; they plan ways to harm me.

8.w: They say, ‘An awful disease overwhelms him, and now that he is bedridden he will never recover.’

9.w: Even my close friend whom I trusted, he who shared meals with me, has turned against me.

10.w: As for you, O Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, so I can pay them back!”

11.w: By this I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

12.w: As for me, you uphold me because of my integrity; you allow me permanent access to your presence.

13.w: The Lord God of Israel deserves praise in the future and forevermore. We agree! We agree!
